What we do

Turning site conditions into engineering plans.

Colosseum Engineering brings together survey, investigation, design and estimation to prepare Detailed Project Reports for infrastructure projects.

Our documented assignments span rural roads, river bridges and public building work in Tripura and West Bengal.
